page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re8.240xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8490H processors running at a base clock speed of 1.9 GHz. The instance features 960 dedicated vCPUs and 16,384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 17.07 GB per vCPU. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 200 Gbps.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. The absence of local NVMe drives and hardware accelerators represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing massive centralized memory capacity and high-core count CPU resources over local disk I/O and parallel graphics processing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.re8.240xlarge offers high resource density for workloads requiring massive memory footprints and substantial parallel processing capabilities on a single node. This profile is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, massive data analytics pipelines, and memory-intensive scientific computing workloads.
